facts.text: Through PBA's Workship community service program, students are required to complete at least 45 hours of community service every year.

sources.title: Honoring 9/11 Through Service - Palm Beach Atlantic University
sources.quote: Workship is PBA's community service program that combines worship and work in response to human needs with Christ-like action in the community and the world. PBA students are required to complete at least 45 hours of Workship every year.
